character: the regime's sandbag walls, never refilled: they SLUMP and POUR: a torn bag sags, sand runs from the rip, the bag goes flat as an empty sack, the sand piles at the foot

strips.layout: column = variant v, row = pair p = ia * 4 + ib (ia, ib = the level index of the start / end vertex)

stages.use: opaque overlay over the cell at dmg/thr crossing 25 / 50 / 75 %; variant h32(x, y, 71) % 4; clip to the body; from 25 % on, the pour stream plays under the rip (pour)

bites.use: one per bullet hit, variant h32(x, y, 80 + salt) % 6, opaque, clipped to the body; each hit also adds sand to the pile

pour.use: under every rip from stage 25 until the bag is empty; stop the loop when the cell is gone; clip the bottom at the first matter or the pile top

pile.use: stage = min(5, cells emptied + hits // 6) of the wall above; swap stages as it grows (no tween); the pile sits on the floor under the wall and may be a slope for actors (alpha = the mask)

facets.#ff0000: top: the art one ramp step lighter
facets.#00ff00: front: the art as it is

chunks.use: as concrete: a removed cell gives 3-6 chunks cut from its own art, turned by 90s, settling on a 36 deg cone with a 1 px contact shadow

behind: the level back plane two steps darker with a contact shadow (as concrete); the first 2 px inside the edge are the burlap's dark inside (#3a3225)
heap: no slabs: the removed bags become the PILE (pile stages) plus 1-3 empty sacks (chunks 1, 5, 7) on it
